title: Smart Bin Recognition – region pack
description: Maps observable bin appearance in one jurisdiction onto canonical waste streams. A region pack is the ONLY place a colour is allowed to mean something. Packs are static JSON, served from the CDN, cached on device, and versioned independently of the app.

region_id.description: Stable id, lowercase, ISO-3166 country first: <country>-<subdivision>-<locality>, e.g. de-by-deggendorf.

taxonomy_version.description: Taxonomy version this pack was authored against. A client with an older taxonomy MUST refuse a pack whose MAJOR is higher.

status.description: Only 'published' packs may be served to end users. 'draft' means rules are unverified against a municipal source.

geohash_tiles.description: Geohash precision 5 (~5x5 km) tiles this pack covers. The client fetches by tile, so a pack may span several.

sources.description: Provenance. A pack MUST NOT reach 'published' status with any source lacking a URL and a retrieval date – every rule shown to a user is traceable to the municipality's own guidance.

rules.description: Evaluated most-specific-first: a rule with more match constraints wins over one with fewer; ties broken by higher confidence, then by array order. The resolver is pure and must be deterministic.

aperture_color.description: v2. Reserved for glass banks with per-slot colour coding.

text_hint.description: v2. Optional OCR token match, e.g. 'Papier'. Never required – the app must work for users who cannot read the local script.

local_name.description: The word printed on the physical object, in the local language. Always shown alongside the translation, never instead of it.

local_names.description: stream id -> local-language name, for streams present in this region.

overrides.description: Per-stream local deltas on the canonical rules. Additive only – a region may add accepted/rejected items and a note, but may not silently redefine what a stream means.

collection_schedule.description: v3. Present in the schema from v1 so schedules can land without a breaking pack version.
